## Distribution (WF-06)

**Current**: Generates RSS item + marks episode as published
**Future**: Auto-publish to podcast platforms

**To add platforms**:
- Spotify/Apple: Upload RSS feed URL to platform dashboards
- YouTube: Add HTTP Request node to YouTube Data API
- Social media: Add nodes for Twitter/LinkedIn/Instagram APIs

**RSS Feed**: The RSS items are generated per-episode. 
A full RSS feed aggregator can be built as a separate endpoint.
